name: post-body-forwarded-created-becomes-200
description: POST body is forwarded verbatim. The API answers 201, but copy-headers removes the http.* properties (including http.status) from the response, so the Mule listener answers with its default 200 and the API body.

source.reference: proxying-a-rest-api/src/main/app/proxying-a-rest-api.xml (second flow-ref copy-headers after http:request removes propertyName="http.*"; http:listener has no response-builder statusCode, default 200)
